original.question: James receives 80 emails a day. 20% of those emails don't require any response. He responds to the rest of them. How many emails does James respond to in a 5 day work week?
original.answer:
James receives 80*20/100=<<80*20/100=16>>16 emails that don't require a response
So he responds to 80-16=<<80-16=64>>64 emails per day
In a 5 day work week, James responds to 64*5=<<64*5=320>> 320 emails
